summary: Nora now keeps track of the work she does on her computer across turns, and sees it at the start of each turn in rooms that use it.
details: Each run of computer work in a room is recorded as a task automatically, from the message that started it; she can list those tasks and how far each got.

In a room that used her computer in the last week, every turn shows her what is there: her open and recently stopped tasks, running jobs, recently changed files and her last commands, each with its age.
A task nobody touches for a day is closed; nothing on the computer is deleted when that happens.
After running a command she answers in her own words instead of pasting its raw output.
limitations: A closed task cannot be resumed as it was; she starts it again when asked.
Only one task is open per room at a time.
